text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, there was a single letter 
placed on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to lock up during training 
just in case, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That letter... Before I knew it, it was 
just sitting right there.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Addressed to the Trainer...? Or is it—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the seal, I saw it was a fan 
letter for Manhattan Cafe—yet for some 
reason, its contents felt slightly 
unsettling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a fan letter, it's quite bizarre, or 
should I say...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is something wrong...? Did something 
strange happen...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's a fan letter addressed to 
Manhattan Cafe, she should be the one to 
read it... Thinking that, I decided to 
hand it over.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"In the morning, rising from the mist— At 
noon, stepping from the rustling trees' 
shade— At night, emerging from the quiet 
darkness—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"‘I will always, always be watching over 
you...’"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... that it's 'that kind of 
thing' after all...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Those who support us aren't just the 
spectators we can see with our eyes...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Just as I watch over 'them,' 'they' are 
cheering me on as well..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That is truly a wonderful thing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day— The letter I had kept in my 
desk drawer had vanished without a trace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Manhattan Cafe said, perhaps it 
really was the work of someone unseen...
